description: List the place categories available in Overture Maps data for a country (or a lat/lng/radius area), with how many places each has. Use this to find valid `categories` values before calling search_places.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. GB. Use this OR lat+lng.

radius.description: Radius in metres for a lat/lng area (max 25000).

name: list_place_categories
